findings.evidence: `Lp.instNorm` (Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/LpSpace/Basic.lean:217) and `Lp.norm_def` (ibid.:227) are unconditional — no `Fact (1 ≤ p)` is needed, so the real-norm form is stateable here with no extra hypotheses.
findings.fix: Add `norm_maximalFunctionLp_le : ‖maximalFunctionLp μ p hp hp_top f‖ ≤ (2 * p.toReal * 2 ^ (p.toReal - 1) / (p.toReal - 1) * 4 ^ finrank ℝ E) ^ (1 / p.toReal) * ‖f‖`, derived from `enorm_maximalFunctionLp_le` via `Lp.norm_def`.
findings.issue: `enorm_maximalFunctionLp_le` is the only bound offered for the new map, and it is stated purely in `ℝ≥0∞`. The whole point of descending to `Lp` (per the PR: "bounded (nonlinear) operator on Lᵖ", moved out of `eLpNorm_maximalFunction_le`'s docstring into this section) is to have a map between normed spaces, but the normed-space statement `‖maximalFunctionLp … f‖ ≤ C * ‖f‖` with a real `C` is missing, so every consumer must redo the `enorm`→`norm` conversion.

findings.evidence: `MeasureTheory.Lp.ext` (Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/LpSpace/Basic.lean:146) and `Lp.coeFn_zero` (ibid.:190) make this a two-line proof; `maximalFunction_zero` applies since `[NormedAddCommGroup F]` supplies `[TopologicalSpace F] [ESeminormedAddMonoid F]`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem maximalFunctionLp_zero : maximalFunctionLp μ p hp hp_top (0 : Lp F p μ) = 0`, proved by `Lp.ext` from `coeFn_maximalFunctionLp`, `Lp.coeFn_zero`, `maximalFunction_congr_ae` and `maximalFunction_zero`.
findings.issue: `maximalFunctionLp` has no lemma relating it to any operation on `Lp`, although the file already develops the representative-level counterparts as `@[simp]` lemmas (`maximalFunction_zero`, line 209; `maximalFunction_const_smul`, line 197). In particular `maximalFunctionLp μ p hp hp_top 0 = 0` — the base normalization of a nonlinear operator — is not available without unfolding through `coeFn_maximalFunctionLp` each time.

findings.evidence: Mathlib makes the analogous type argument explicit for exactly this reason: `LpToLpRestrictCLM X F 𝕜 μ p s` (Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Integral/Bochner/Set.lean:1006).
findings.fix: Make `F` explicit: `maximalFunctionLp (μ : Measure E) (F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup F] (p : ℝ≥0∞) (hp : 1 < p) (hp_top : p ≠ ∞) : Lp F p μ → Lp ℝ p μ`, and update the four downstream lemmas.
findings.issue: `F` is implicit in `maximalFunctionLp` and occurs only in the result type `Lp F p μ → Lp ℝ p μ`, so the point-free term `maximalFunctionLp μ p hp hp_top` does not elaborate (unresolved `?F`). Stating any property of the map itself — continuity, sublinearity as an operator, comparison with another operator — then requires a `(F := _)` ascription.

summary: The new quotient-level surface is minimal and unexposed, with `coeFn_maximalFunctionLp`/`coeFn_maximalFunctionLp_toLp` as an adequate defining API, but the characteristic API of `maximalFunctionLp` is incomplete: the advertised boundedness is stated only in `ℝ≥0∞`, there is no interaction with the `Lp` operations already handled at representative level, and the codomain type variable is not inferable.
